newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Tallinna Pank in '96 49 mln kroon profit.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Tallinna Pank in '96 49 mln kroon profit.

text.p: Estonia's fourth largest bank, Tallinna Pank, said on Monday that its 1996 profit was 48.6 million kroons and its net assets rose to 2.167 billion kroons versus 1.1 billion in 1995.
"The bank visibly beat the 45 million (1996) profit forecast," Rait Luukas, bank chairman, said in a statement.
Net assets rose due to bigger time and demand deposits, which rose 89 percent to 1.35 billion kroons, the bank added.
The bank's loan portfolio rose to 1.24 billion kroons in 1996 from 582 million kroons in 1995 and share capital was 96 million kroons versus 48 million in 1995, it said.
